sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate is a verified controlled limit or criterion term for defining the minor-relative-to relationship; relevantStructuralDimension is only the dimensional operand, while calculationCase and ship are owner concepts.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove the nested sh:property requiring nltl:calculationMethod sh:minCount 1 for every nltl:hasCalculationCase value. Applicability is conditional on a case having calculationMethod nltl:nonlinearCalculationMethodValue; the current Core constraint incorrectly fails ships with non-nonlinear calculation cases lacking a method. Keep method selection and all required evidence/quantity checks scoped to nonlinear cases in the bounded SPARQL constraints.
